_comment: Per-platform low/medium/high model tiers for spinning up a SUBAGENT at a given effort (never applies to a human's own top-level model choice). Consumed by scripts/guardlib/model_family.py as a soft nudge, and meant to be read by the orchestrating agent BEFORE calling Agent/Task so it can pick the right model up front. 'effort' fields are UNVERIFIED (verified: false) for all three platforms -- we do not yet know which platforms can set effort for a non-interactively-created session, or how. Flagged in candidates/pending-verification/.
